source_refs.note: Book p. 285-287: 14.4.4 determinant formula for u.(v x w) in components; Example 23 (dot and cross interchange), 24 (i.j x k = 1), 25 (parallelepiped, 48), 26 (tetrahedron, 2/3). Teaching notes, Key points, mistakes are ours.

items.title: 14.4.4 Scalar Triple Product of Vectors in Terms of Components (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Ab tak humne scalar triple product ka matlab samjha: yeh volume hai. Lekin sawal mein vectors aksar components mein diye hote hain, jaise \(\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\). To ab hum woh tareeqa seekhte hain jis se yeh number seedha components se nikal aaye. Khushkhabri: poora hisaab ek \(3\times 3\) determinant ban jata hai, jo aap pehle se nikalna jaante hain. Is page par kitab ki chaar misaalen (Examples 23-26) bhi hain.

Let \(\underline{u} = a_1\underline{i} + b_1\underline{j} + c_1\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = a_2\underline{i} + b_2\underline{j} + c_2\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{w} = a_3\underline{i} + b_3\underline{j} + c_3\underline{k}\).

Pehle \(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}\) nikalte hain:
\[\underline{v}\times \underline{w} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ a_2 & b_2 & c_2 \\ a_3 & b_3 & c_3 \end{vmatrix}\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Yeh 14.3 wala cross product ka determinant formula hi hai: \(\underline{i}\) wale term ke liye pehla column kaat do, \(\underline{j}\) wale ke liye doosra (aur saamne minus), \(\underline{k}\) wale ke liye teesra. Naya kuch nahin, bas purana auzaar istemal ho raha hai.

Ab \(\underline{u}\) ke saath dot product lete hain:
\[\therefore\ \underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w})\]
\[= a_1(b_2c_3 - b_3c_2)\]
\[- b_1(a_2c_3 - a_3c_2)\]
\[+ c_1(a_2b_3 - a_3b_2)\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Dot product ka rule: milte julte components zarb karo aur jama karo. \(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}\) ka \(\underline{i}\) wala hissa \(a_1\) se zarb hua, \(\underline{j}\) wala \(b_1\) se, \(\underline{k}\) wala \(c_1\) se. Ab ghaur se dekhiye: yeh bilkul wahi shakal hai jo \(3\times 3\) determinant ko pehli row par kholne se aati hai, jis ki pehli row \(a_1, b_1, c_1\) ho. Yani poora hisaab ek determinant mein samet sakte hain:

blocks.latex: \underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}) = \begin{vmatrix} a_1 & b_1 & c_1 \\ a_2 & b_2 & c_2 \\ a_3 & b_3 & c_3 \end{vmatrix}
blocks.text_alt: u dot (v cross w) equals the determinant with rows a1 b1 c1, a2 b2 c2, a3 b3 c3

blocks.text: Isay \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) ke scalar triple product ka component form mein determinant formula kehte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Istemal ka tareeqa: teeno vectors ke components teen rows mein likho, usi tarteeb se jis mein woh \([\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\) mein hain, aur expand kar do. Bas itna hi!
Determinant ke do rules se triple product ki saari properties samajh aa jati hain:
1. Do rows ki jagah badlo to sign badal jata hai. Is liye do vectors ki jagah badalne se sign badalta hai: \([\underline{v}\ \underline{u}\ \underline{w}] = -[\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\).
2. Cyclic tabdeeli \(\underline{u}, \underline{v}, \underline{w} \to \underline{v}, \underline{w}, \underline{u}\) asal mein do dafa jagah badalna hai, is liye sign nahin badalta. Yeh 14.4.1 aur 14.4.2 wali baat ka teesra saboot hai: \([\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}] = [\underline{v}\ \underline{w}\ \underline{u}] = [\underline{w}\ \underline{u}\ \underline{v}]\).
Aur ek kaam ki baat: jis determinant ki do rows bilkul ek jaisi hon us ki value zero hoti hai. Yeh 14.4.5 mein kaam aayegi.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
14.4.1 wali misaal yaad hai? \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + \underline{j}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = \underline{i} + \underline{k}\). Wahan humne pehle cross phir dot kar ke 2 nikala tha. Ab seedha determinant se (yeh hamara sawal hai):
\[\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 1(1 - 0) - 1(0 - 1) + 0(0 - 1)\]
\[= 1 + 1 + 0 = 2\]
Wahi jawab, magar ek hi qadam mein. Isi liye exam mein determinant wala tareeqa sab se tez hai.
Ab kitab ki misaalen dekhte hain. Pehli misaal ek saboot (proof) hai, phir hisaab wali misaalen.

blocks.title: Example 23
blocks.problem: Prove that dot and cross product are inter changeable in scalar triple product.
steps:
Given: \(\underline{u} = a_1\underline{i} + b_1\underline{j} + c_1\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = a_2\underline{i} + b_2\underline{j} + c_2\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = a_3\underline{i} + b_3\underline{j} + c_3\underline{k}\), koi bhi teen vectors.
To prove: \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}) = (\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\cdot \underline{w}\).
Method: sab se pehle samajhiye ke sawal kya keh raha hai: left side mein pehle dot hai phir cross, right side mein pehle cross phir dot. Humein dikhana hai ke jagah badalne se jawab nahin badalta. Plan: left side ko determinant ki shakal mein likhenge, phir rows ki jagah badal kar right side tak pahunchenge. Determinant ka rule: do rows ki jagah badlo to sign badal jata hai; do dafa badlo to sign wapas aa jata hai.

Step 1: Determinant formula likhein
\[\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}) = \begin{vmatrix} a_1 & b_1 & c_1 \\ a_2 & b_2 & c_2 \\ a_3 & b_3 & c_3 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: yeh wahi formula hai jo abhi upar derive kiya. Is ki rows tarteeb se \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\), \(\underline{w}\) ke components hain.

Step 2: \(R_1\) aur \(R_2\) ki jagah badlein
\[= -\begin{vmatrix} a_2 & b_2 & c_2 \\ a_1 & b_1 & c_1 \\ a_3 & b_3 & c_3 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: determinant ki do rows ki jagah badalne se us ki value \(-1\) se zarb ho jati hai. Is liye saamne minus lagana zaroori hai, warna barabari toot jayegi.

Step 3: Ab \(R_1\) aur \(R_3\) ki jagah badlein
\[= \begin{vmatrix} a_3 & b_3 & c_3 \\ a_1 & b_1 & c_1 \\ a_2 & b_2 & c_2 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: doosri dafa jagah badli to phir \(-1\) se zarb hua. Pehle wala minus aur yeh naya minus mil kar \((-1)(-1) = +1\) ban gaye, is liye minus ghaib ho gaya.

Step 4: Naye determinant ko triple product ki shakal mein parhein
\[= \underline{w}\cdot(\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\]
\[= (\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\cdot \underline{w}\]
Kyun: ab rows tarteeb se \(\underline{w}\), \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\) hain, to determinant formula ke mutabiq yeh \(\underline{w}\cdot(\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\) hai. Dot product commutative hai (\(\underline{a}\cdot \underline{b} = \underline{b}\cdot \underline{a}\)), jaise \(2\times 3 = 3\times 2\); is liye ise \((\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\cdot \underline{w}\) bhi likh sakte hain.

Step 5: Nateeja
\[\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}) = (\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\cdot \underline{w}\]
Kyun: hum left side se chale aur sirf jaiz (allowed) qadmon se right side tak pahunch gaye. Left mein dot pehle aur cross baad mein tha; right mein ulat. Yani dot aur cross ki jagah badalne se kuch nahin badla.

Tasdeeq: numbers rakh kar dekhte hain: \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + \underline{j}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = \underline{i} + \underline{k}\).
\(\underline{v}\times \underline{w} = \underline{i} + \underline{j} - \underline{k}\), to \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}) = 1 + 1 + 0 = 2\).
\(\underline{u}\times \underline{v} = \underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}\), to \((\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\cdot \underline{w} = 1 + 0 + 1 = 2\).
Dono taraf 2. Saboot aur misaal dono ek hi baat keh rahe hain.
blocks.answer: \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}) = (\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\cdot \underline{w}\): scalar triple product mein dot aur cross ki jagah badli ja sakti hai. Saabit ho gaya.

blocks.title: Example 24
blocks.problem: Assuming \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\) and \(\underline{k}\) are unit vectors in a cartesian coordinate system. Prove that \(\underline{i}\cdot \underline{j}\times \underline{k} = \underline{j}\cdot \underline{k}\times \underline{i} = \underline{k}\cdot \underline{i}\times \underline{j}\).
steps:
Given: \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\) \(x\), \(y\), \(z\) axes ki seedh mein unit vectors (lambai 1 wale vectors) hain.
To prove: \(\underline{i}\cdot \underline{j}\times \underline{k} = \underline{j}\cdot \underline{k}\times \underline{i} = \underline{k}\cdot \underline{i}\times \underline{j}\).
Method: har unit vector ko components mein likhenge (jo component nahin hai woh 0), phir teeno triple products determinant formula se nikalenge aur dikhayenge ke teeno ka jawab ek hi number hai.

Step 1: Unit vectors ko components mein likhein
\[\underline{i} = \underline{i} + 0\underline{j} + 0\underline{k}\]
\[\underline{j} = 0\underline{i} + \underline{j} + 0\underline{k}\]
\[\underline{k} = 0\underline{i} + 0\underline{j} + \underline{k}\]
Kyun: determinant formula ko har vector ke teen components chahiyen. \(\underline{i}\) mein \(\underline{j}\) aur \(\underline{k}\) wale hisse nahin, is liye un ki jagah 0 likha.

Step 2: \(\underline{i}\cdot \underline{j}\times \underline{k}\) nikalein
\[\underline{i}\cdot \underline{j}\times \underline{k} = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 1(1 - 0) - 0(0 - 1) + 0(0 - 0)\]
\[= 1\]
Kyun: rows tarteeb se \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\) ke components hain. Pehli row par \(+, -, +\) ke saath expand kiya; sirf pehla term bacha kyun ke baaqi elements zero hain.

Step 3: \(\underline{j}\cdot \underline{k}\times \underline{i}\) nikalein
\[\underline{j}\cdot \underline{k}\times \underline{i} = \begin{vmatrix} 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 0(0 - 0) - 1(0 - 1) + 0(0 - 0)\]
\[= 1\]
Kyun: ab rows \(\underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\), \(\underline{i}\) hain. Pehli row mein sirf beech wala element 1 hai, aur us ka sign minus hai: \(-1(0 - 1) = +1\). Dhyan dein: yahan minus aur minus mil kar plus bane.

Step 4: \(\underline{k}\cdot \underline{i}\times \underline{j}\) nikalein
\[\underline{k}\cdot \underline{i}\times \underline{j} = \begin{vmatrix} 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 0(0 - 0) - 0(0 - 1) + 1(1 - 0)\]
\[= 1\]
Kyun: rows \(\underline{k}\), \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\) hain; sirf aakhri term bachta hai, \(+1(1 - 0) = 1\).

Step 5: Nateeja
\[\underline{i}\cdot \underline{j}\times \underline{k} = \underline{j}\cdot \underline{k}\times \underline{i} = \underline{k}\cdot \underline{i}\times \underline{j} = 1\]
Kyun: teeno ki value 1 aayi, is liye teeno barabar hain. Ghaur karein ke yeh teeno cyclic shaklen hain, isi liye barabar aayin.

Tasdeeq: 14.3 se yaad kijiye: \(\underline{j}\times \underline{k} = \underline{i}\), \(\underline{k}\times \underline{i} = \underline{j}\), \(\underline{i}\times \underline{j} = \underline{k}\). To teeno products \(\underline{i}\cdot \underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\cdot \underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\cdot \underline{k}\) ban jate hain, aur har ek 1 hai. Geometry mein yeh side 1 wale cube (unit cube) ka volume hai, jo 1 hi hona chahiye.

blocks.text: Ab do hisaab wali misaalen aa rahi hain, aur dono mein ek ahem farq hai jo pehle hi samajh lijiye. Example 25 mein vectors seedhe diye gaye hain, to un ke components foran determinant mein ja sakte hain, aur jawab poora determinant hai (parallelepiped). Example 26 mein vectors nahin, chaar points diye gaye hain; wahan pehle ek kone se teen edges banana parenge, aur aakhir mein \(\frac{1}{6}\) lagana parega (tetrahedron). Sawal parhte hi pehla sawal khud se poochiye: "mujhe vectors diye gaye hain ya points? Dabba hai ya tetrahedron?" Aadha kaam yahin ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Example 25
blocks.problem: Find the volume of the parallelepiped determined by \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = \underline{i} - 7\underline{j} - 4\underline{k}\).
steps:
Given: \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = \underline{i} - 7\underline{j} - 4\underline{k}\).
To find: in teen vectors ko edges maan kar bane parallelepiped ka volume.
Method: 14.4.2 se pata hai ke volume scalar triple product \(\underline{u}\cdot \underline{v}\times \underline{w}\) hai, aur 14.4.4 ka determinant formula ise components se seedha nikal deta hai. Plan: determinant banao, pehli row par expand karo, teeno terms jama karo.

Step 1: Determinant banayein
\[V = \underline{u}\cdot \underline{v}\times \underline{w}\]
\[= \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 & -1 \\ 1 & -2 & 3 \\ 1 & -7 & -4 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: pehli row \(\underline{u}\) ke components, doosri \(\underline{v}\) ke, teesri \(\underline{w}\) ke. Dhyan dein: \(-\underline{k}\) ka component \(-1\) hai, aur har sign apne number ke saath jata hai.

Step 2: Pehla term (element 1, sign \(+\))
\[1\big[(-2)(-4) - (3)(-7)\big]\]
\[= 1(8 + 21) = 29\]
Kyun: row 1 aur column 1 ko dimagh mein kaat dein; bacha hua \(\begin{vmatrix} -2 & 3 \\ -7 & -4 \end{vmatrix}\) hai. Cross multiply: \((-2)(-4) = 8\) aur \((3)(-7) = -21\); \(8 - (-21) = 29\).

Step 3: Doosra term (element 2, sign \(-\))
\[-2\big[(1)(-4) - (3)(1)\big]\]
\[= -2(-4 - 3) = 14\]
Kyun: pehli row ka beech wala element hamesha minus ke saath aata hai. Bracket \(-7\) aaya, aur \(-2\times -7 = +14\). Yahi woh jagah hai jahan sab se zyada ghaltiyan hoti hain.

Step 4: Teesra term (element \(-1\), sign \(+\))
\[+(-1)\big[(1)(-7) - (-2)(1)\big]\]
\[= -1(-7 + 2) = 5\]
Kyun: row 1 aur column 3 kaat dein; bacha \(\begin{vmatrix} 1 & -2 \\ 1 & -7 \end{vmatrix}\). \((1)(-7) = -7\) aur \((-2)(1) = -2\); \(-7 - (-2) = -5\); phir \(-1\times -5 = 5\).

Step 5: Teeno terms jama karein
\[V = 29 + 14 + 5 = 48\]
Kyun: determinant teeno terms ka majmooa (sum) hai. Jawab positive hai, is liye yahi volume hai; sign hatane ki zaroorat nahin.

Tasdeeq: doosre tareeqe se: pehle \(\underline{v}\times \underline{w} = 29\underline{i} + 7\underline{j} - 5\underline{k}\) nikalein, phir \(\underline{u}\) se dot: \((1)(29) + (2)(7) + (-1)(-5) = 29 + 14 + 5 = 48\). Bilkul wahi jawab.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Volume ke sawal mein jawab ke saath unit zaroor likhiye: cubic units. Agar determinant negative aaye to volume us ki absolute value hai; minus hata kar likhiye aur ek line mein wajah bhi likh dijiye.

blocks.title: Example 26
blocks.problem: Find the volume of the tetrahedron whose vertices are \(A(2, 1, 8)\), \(B(3, 2, 9)\), \(C(2, 1, 4)\) and \(D(3, 3, 0)\).
steps:
Given: kone \(A(2, 1, 8)\), \(B(3, 2, 9)\), \(C(2, 1, 4)\), \(D(3, 3, 0)\).
To find: tetrahedron \(ABCD\) ka volume.
Method: yahan vectors nahin, points diye gaye hain. To pehle ek kone (\(A\)) se teen edges \(\underline{AB}\), \(\underline{AC}\), \(\underline{AD}\) banayenge, phir 14.4.3 ka formula \(V = \frac{1}{6}[\underline{AB}\ \underline{AC}\ \underline{AD}]\) lagayenge.

Step 1: Edge \(\underline{AB}\)
\[\underline{AB} = \underline{OB} - \underline{OA}\]
\[= (3-2)\underline{i} + (2-1)\underline{j} + (9-8)\underline{k}\]
\[= \underline{i} + \underline{j} + \underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(A\) se \(B\) tak ka vector = \(B\) ka position vector \(-\) \(A\) ka position vector. Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: "aakhri point minus shuru wala point".

Step 2: Edge \(\underline{AC}\)
\[\underline{AC} = \underline{OC} - \underline{OA}\]
\[= (2-2)\underline{i} + (1-1)\underline{j} + (4-8)\underline{k}\]
\[= 0\underline{i} + 0\underline{j} - 4\underline{k}\]
Kyun: wahi rule. Yahan \(\underline{i}\) aur \(\underline{j}\) wale hisse zero aaye; koi baat nahin, zero bhi component hai aur determinant mein likha jayega.

Step 3: Edge \(\underline{AD}\)
\[\underline{AD} = \underline{OD} - \underline{OA}\]
\[= (3-2)\underline{i} + (3-1)\underline{j} + (0-8)\underline{k}\]
\[= \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - 8\underline{k}\]
Kyun: wahi rule. Teeno edges \(A\) se shuru hain, jaisa formula chahta hai.

Step 4: Formula mein rakhein
\[V = \dfrac{1}{6}[\underline{AB}\ \underline{AC}\ \underline{AD}]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{6}\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 \\ 1 & 2 & -8 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: rows \(\underline{AB}\), \(\underline{AC}\), \(\underline{AD}\) ke components hain. Dhyan dein: points ke coordinates determinant mein nahin jate, edges ke components jate hain.

Step 5: Pehli row par expand karein
\[= \dfrac{1}{6}\big[1(0 + 8) - 1(0 + 4) + 1(0 - 0)\big]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{6}(8 - 4) = \dfrac{4}{6} = \dfrac{2}{3}\]
Kyun: pehla term \(1\big[(0)(-8) - (-4)(2)\big] = 8\); doosra (minus wala) \(-1\big[(0)(-8) - (-4)(1)\big] = -4\); teesra \(1\big[(0)(2) - (0)(1)\big] = 0\). Phir \(\frac{4}{6}\) ko simplest form \(\frac{2}{3}\) mein likha.

Tasdeeq: \(\underline{AC}\times \underline{AD} = 8\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} + 0\underline{k}\) nikalein, phir \(\underline{AB}\cdot(\underline{AC}\times \underline{AD}) = 8 - 4 + 0 = 4\). To \(V = \frac{4}{6} = \frac{2}{3}\). Jawab positive hai, sign ka masla nahin.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
\([\underline{u}\ \underline{u}\ \underline{w}]\) kitna hoga, chahe \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) kuch bhi hon? Pehle khud sochiye.
Jawab: zero. Determinant ki do rows (pehli aur doosri) bilkul ek jaisi hain, aur aise determinant ki value zero hoti hai. Geometry mein bhi: \(\underline{u}\times \underline{u} = \underline{0}\), to dabba ban hi nahin sakta. Yeh 14.4.5 ki Property 2 hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \([\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}] = \begin{vmatrix} a_1 & b_1 & c_1 \\ a_2 & b_2 & c_2 \\ a_3 & b_3 & c_3 \end{vmatrix}\): rows \(\underline{u}, \underline{v}, \underline{w}\) ki tarteeb mein.
2. Do rows (vectors) ki jagah badlo to sign badalta hai; cyclic tabdeeli se nahin.
3. Dot aur cross jagah badal sakte hain: \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}) = (\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\cdot \underline{w}\).
4. \(\underline{i}\cdot \underline{j}\times \underline{k} = 1\) (unit cube ka volume).
5. Parallelepiped: \(V = |[\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]|\); tetrahedron \(ABCD\): \(V = \frac{1}{6}|[\underline{AB}\ \underline{AC}\ \underline{AD}]|\).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Expansion mein beech wale term ka minus bhool jana. Bachne ka tareeqa: pehle \(+\;-\;+\) likh lo, phir numbers bharo.
2. Row mein negative sign kho dena, jaise \(-7\) ko \(7\) likh dena. Determinant banate waqt har component sign samet utaariye.
3. Tetrahedron ke sawal mein points ke coordinates hi determinant mein rakh dena. Pehle edges \(\underline{AB}, \underline{AC}, \underline{AD}\) banayein.
4. Tetrahedron mein \(\frac{1}{6}\) bhool jana; parallelepiped mein nahin lagta, tetrahedron mein zaroor.
